Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: isolated transparent 2D stylized hand-drawn stage-tower sprite, iteration 2 for Karen's Promise Pile.
USER CORRECTION: the prior painted tower was TOO REALISTIC, too much like a tiny real building or architectural model. This revision must be visibly flatter, much simpler, more theatrical and expressive. Do NOT recreate the realistic tower.
Reference image: an actual Slay the Spire 2 mod screenshot. The sparse red wireframe tower behind the girl is the SHAPE reference. Karen and the game's chunky flat art are rendering references. Do not include the screenshot, background, character, or UI in the output.
PRIMARY DESIGN: turn that sparse existing wireframe into a graceful hand-drawn theatrical cutout evoking Revue Starlight's tower of promise. A fantasy game illustration of the SYMBOL of Tokyo Tower. Preserve a tall narrow tip, two simple slim horizontal stage ledges and elegantly outward-flared curved legs with a generous arch opening. Front-facing with absolutely no perspective depth. Only TWO visible legs, NO rear legs. About 2.1 times taller than wide. Thin long curving outer supports, slightly stylized asymmetry. Only 4 or 5 generously spaced internal diagonal cross-braces TOTAL; broad airy negative space is essential. NO dense scaffolding.
Render as clean expressive 2D anime cel illustration with the economical graphic shapes of Slay the Spire 2 props: 3 or 4 flat color values, muted vermilion/coral red main shapes, one soft wine-red shadow shape, selective warm golden edge strokes. Subtle irregular painterly contour, almost no surface texture. NOT thick uniform black cartoon outline. NO volumetric gradients, facets, realistic bevels, realistic metallic specular reflections, tiny brush dabs, deep recesses, realistic lighting or 3D modelling.
The observation decks are slender graphic horizontal ledges, NOT realistic windowed boxes. NO windows, railings, rivets, rectangular foundation blocks, realistic concrete footings, cable antenna arrays or striped radio mast. End the tip in one slender expressive red point; an optional tiny warm tip accent only. Do not add extra decorations, ribbons, curtains, hanging objects, stars or UI labels. The tower itself should feel light, a painted silhouette given a hint of warmth, not a massive building.
Use open transparent interior gaps; every structural opening is actual alpha transparency. Outer edges must be crisp at game scale, preserve negative space at 350 pixels height.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, no simulated transparency checkerboard, no floor, no background, no drop shadow, no bloom or colored mist. One complete isolated tower, centered on a portrait canvas with all tips and legs visible and comfortable margins.
Anti-artifact finish: clean low-frequency flat color, remove AI moire, periodic grids, fine hatch marks, speckle, paper/canvas texture, synthetic microdetail and ringing. No text, numbers, watermark or logos.
